integrity_notes: Proof is analytic; accompanying reproducible numerical checks are supplementary. No independent historical-priority verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Three independent Poisson founding sites; two identical higher efficiencies and one non-greater efficiency.
At least two sites need a single successful founder; no assertion of post-founding persistence.
Does not cover correlated habitats, integer budgets, heterogeneous triplets without the two-equal assumption, or Allee thresholds above one founder.
Earlier general reliability literature could contain an equivalent specialized allocation; direct comparison to its complete 1974 and 1975 texts was unavailable.
title: A budget-independent weak-patch threshold for two-site establishment
